paragraphs: R' Yudan, son of Rabbi Shmuel.
Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 15:2. Hyman says it appears that it SHOULD READ R' Yudan in the name of R' Shmuel (bar Nachmani).[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״טו-ב is read as chapter 15 section 2, without independent edition verification; machine פ״טודב differs from the supplied locator.

ונראה keeps Hyman’s suggestion tentative: he proposes changing son-of into an in-the-name-of relation. The parenthetical bar Nachmani is supplied by Hyman. ברבי explicitly expands the father’s heading title to Rabbi, but the separately proposed ר׳ שמואל remains R'; neither occurrence lends its title to the other. The hedge IT APPEARS and the directive SHOULD READ both retain their force.
